notes.title: 🎮 MEGA UPDATE IS HERE! 🎮
notes.content:
[p]This massive patch brings major improvements across the board, with a strong focus on [b]performance optimization[/b] and [b]gameplay polish[/b] for the entire [i]Barcha[/i] experience.[/p][p][b]What’s New:[/b][/p][p]🔪 [b]+2 Hours of New Gameplay![/b]
Dive into the all-new [b]"Purple Action"[/b] storyline — set 15 years after the terrifying events of [i]Barcha[/i]. Discover what happened next in this haunting new chapter...[/p][p]🛡️ [b]New Mini-Game Added![/b]
Try the new [b]Tank Movement Mini-Game[/b] with a fixed-camera, retro-inspired style — a unique third storyline to test your nerves and reflexes![/p][p]⚙️ [b]Improved Performance & Visual Polish[/b]
We’ve gone under the hood to clean up bugs, smooth out the experience, and make the horror hit harder than ever.[/p][hr][/hr][p]🎉 Enjoy the update, and don’t forget to [b]like[/b], [b]comment[/b], and share your thoughts.
💀 Thank you all so much for the amazing support — it means everything![img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45536906/1e628a6b1f5d3dc9e80051a2120e8552a9629061.jpg"][/img][/p]

notes.title: Major update version 1.2 live
notes.content:
We’re excited to announce that Version 1.2 of Barcha is now live! 🎉

What’s New in This Update?
✅ Gameplay Improvements – Smoother mechanics and enhanced performance.
✅ Lighting & Post-Processing Fixes – Better visuals for a more immersive experience.

Thank you for your support, and we hope you enjoy the latest update! Let us know your feedback.

See you in the game! 🎮✨

notes.title: New Update: Skip Story Button Added!
notes.content:
We’ve listened to your feedback, and we're excited to announce that we've added a "Skip Story" button in the game! We noticed that some players prefer to skip longer story sections, so now you can easily move forward without missing a beat.

We hope this makes your experience even better, and we appreciate your continued support!

notes.title: Major update
notes.content:
After thorough testing by our team and valuable feedback from several curators, we’re excited to announce that Barcha will be receiving a major update. This update will include:

Performance improvements

New levels and characters

Enhanced storylines

Increased interactivity

As a result, the game’s release will be delayed. We appreciate your understanding and patience as we work to deliver the best possible experience!
